text:
maria.chen: Anyone know where the hot-key / prefix cache hit-rate dashboard lives for runtime-proxy? digging into latency spikes in prod this morning.

observability-bot: Hi @maria.chen — there's a dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/kv-prefix/hot-keys-and-hitrate?orgId=1&var-service=runtime-proxy :mag_right:

sam.patel: That panel has the PromQL we use:```
(sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{service="runtime-proxy"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{service="runtime-proxy"}[5m]))) * 100
```Shows 5m rolling hit-rate as percent. For top prefixes use label_replace on `prefix` and topk(10, ...).

alex.gomez: fyi alerts are currently: `kv_prefix_hitrate < 60` for 10m. It's been noisy on bursts. I recommend either bumping to 15m or changing to a weighted metric that ignores tiny-count prefixes.

lia.torres: Where do I add the deploy annotation so we can correlate? want to mark the window for the spike.

sam.patel: In Grafana -> dashboard settings -> Annotations. We pull `deploy_tag` from our tracing events; or just add a manual annotation and include `k8s/deploy` and the commit sha.

jordan.lee: pinging @eng-sre to check if any scaling blips. We saw a short CPU surge at 08:12UTC which lines up with the hit-rate dip.

alex.gomez: Another quick query to surface hot keys (prefix frequency):```
topk(20, sum by (prefix) (rate(kv_cache_requests_total{service="runtime-proxy"}[5m])))
```export the list and check TTLs.

maria.chen: awesome — I'll pull top 20 and TTLs, then compare against recent deploys. If hot keys are skewed we may need prefetch or longer TTL for those prefixes. :eyes:

observability-bot: Bookmarked dashboard for @maria.chen and added read-only panel link: https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/kv-prefix/hot-keys-and-hitrate?panelId=4

lia.torres: can someone add a short note on the runbook where to find these queries? I couldn't find the doc.

sam.patel: added a snippet to the eng-platform runbook (internal Confluence) under Observability -> KV Cache -> Queries/Alerts. I'll link it when it's up.

maria.chen: thanks all — will update thread with findings. if we need an alert tune change i'll open a PR to ops-alerts repo and cc @eng-sre. :thumbsup:
